name: Companion
description: AAC follows the conversation in the room instead of waiting for its name: for every new line a quick model reads the last minutes (who said what, and what AAC said) and decides whether AAC should answer. Use it instead of the Wake word module (not both).

mode.title: When AAC speaks
options: When it is spoken to (by name, a reply to it, or clearly meant for it)
May also join in when it can clearly help (careful)

minutes.title: Conversation it follows (minutes)
minutes.help: How far back the decision reads the room (1–30).
